name: Devs Accounting – All-in-One Accounting Solution
author: DevsBrain

sections.description:
This is a simple plugin that allows you to manage your business accounting on your WordPress admin dashboard. You can add items and manage inventory, crate income and expense, can create invoice for your customers and track your acccounts. It also provides automatic reports.

Short Description

A simple plugin that allows you to Easily manage your business accounting, invoice, inventory and get automated reports .

Features

  • Easy-to-use interface for generating QR codes
  • Customize the color, design, and eye style of your QR codes
  • View and download all your created QR codes from the admin dashboard
  • It provides shortcode, which can shown easily in the sidebard, posts, products and footer etc where you want to show it.

Need Any Help?

  • Please mail us at devsbrainctg@gmail.com
  • We provide live support

Usage

  1. Go to Devs Accounting You can see dashboard.
  2. In settings page you can set your company name, address, payment method etc.
  3. Go to add category to add category for Item, Income and Expense separately.
  4. In items you can add items or products with price, category and photos.
  5. In transactions you can add income and expense for separate category.
  6. To add an invoice you need to go to invoices and click add.
  7. You can see reports in reports section.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 (or later) license.

Support

If you need any assistance or have any questions about the plugin, please open a support ticket and we will be happy to help.

Contribution

If you want to contribute to the development of the plugin, you can submit a pull request on the plugin’s Github repository.
sections.installation:
1. Login to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on the “Upload Plugin” button.
  4. Choose the plugin zip file and click on the “Install Now” button.
  5. Activate the plugin and check it in the settings link.
